title: Don't Pay Attention, PLANT It: Pretraining Attention via Learning-to-Rank
abstract: arXiv:2410.23066v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: State-of-the-art Extreme Multi-Label Text Classification models rely on multi-label attention to focus on key tokens in input text, but learning good attention weights is challenging. We introduce PLANT (Pretrained and Leveraged AtteNTion), a plug-and-play strategy for initializing the label-attention module that operates on top of an LLM's output representations. PLANT works by planting label-specific attention using a Learning-to-Rank model trained on mutual information gain, before end-to-end fine-tuning. This architecture-agnostic approach integrates with LLM backbones (e.g., Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, DeepSeek-V3, and Phi-3-mini). PLANT outperforms SOTA methods across tasks like ICD coding, legal topic classification, and content recommendation, and improves fine-tuned LLMs in controlled comparisons outside the medical domain. translated_title: 无需费力学注意力，直接“种下”它：通过学习排序预训练注意力
translated_abstract: 最先进的极端多标签文本分类模型依赖多标签注意力机制来聚焦输入文本中的关键标记，但学习良好的注意力权重十分具有挑战性。我们提出了PLANT（Pretrained and Leveraged AtteNTion，预训练并利用的注意力），这是一种即插即用的策略，用于初始化构建在大语言模型输出表示之上的标签注意力模块。PLANT的工作方式是：在端到端微调之前，利用一个基于互信息增益训练的学习排序模型来“种下”（植入）标签特定的注意力。这种与架构无关的方法可与多种大语言模型骨干网络（如Mistral-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、DeepSeek-V3和Phi-3-mini）集成。PLANT在ICD编码、法律主题分类和内容推荐等任务上超越了现有最先进方法，并在医疗领域之外的受控对比实验中改进了微调后的大语言模型。其收益在罕见标签上最为显著，尽管免训练的大语言模型抽取基线仍具有竞争力。
tldr: 提出PLANT，一种即插即用策略，通过基于互信息增益的学习排序模型预训练标签注意力来初始化注意力模块，可与大语言模型骨干集成，在极端多标签文本分类任务上超越现有最先进方法，且在罕见标签上收益最大。
en_tdlr: PLANT is a plug-and-play strategy that pretrains label-specific attention via a learning-to-rank model trained on mutual information gain, integrating with LLM backbones to outperform SOTA in extreme multi-label text classification, with the largest gains on rare labels.
